answer: Trading capacity is leased by the voyage, a ten-epoch term that expires and must be re-bought by burning saffron. The mirror joins keys whose earnings ever land in a common wallet, and an operator renewing its k-th joined key burns 4k² saffron per voyage. A single key renews for 4 saffron. A 50-key farm burns 171,700 saffron every voyage, and burned saffron never returns. To stay off the mirror, each clone must never merge its profits and must cash out through its own separately verified exit account.
